name: Apex

product.what_it_is: Macrocosmos' competition platform: a problem is posted with a scoring function, miners submit Python solutions, validators score them and the best solution wins emissions. The pitch is that enterprises bring their optimisation problems; today the competitions are internal (Text Clustering with SN13/arXiv data, Humanoid Olympics, Humanoid Box Scramble).
product.quality_rationale: Live and actively developed (subnetradar: 55 commits in 30d, 246 miners) but usable mainly by miners; no external customer-run competition, and apex.macrocosmos.ai showed '0 active landscape, 0 running today, 0.00α paid out' on 2026-10-08.

revenue.basis: Only inbound money disclosed is a $20 miner submission fee on two competitions; no submission counts, no customer revenue, not in any revenue index. Nothing to annualise.
revenue.evidence: Verified 2026-10-08: docs FAQ reads 'Submission fees are variable per competition. If a competition is not listed here, then it's free to submit to.' with 'Text Clustering: $20 USD' and 'Humanoid Olympics: $20 USD'. Docs still solicit customers: 'Want to transform your idea into a competition on Apex? Reach out to us through email at hello@macrocosmos.ai.' apex.macrocosmos.ai shows '0 active landscape', '0 running today', '0.00α paid out'. Apex absent from Crypto Briefing's SubConnect coverage (2026-09-21) and from TAO Daily's SubConnect tables (2026-09-16, 2026-10-02).

growth.evidence: No dated revenue figure exists at any point in time; only usage signal is the dashboard showing zero running competitions and zero alpha paid out on 2026-10-08.

customers.evidence: The only named competition partner is internal to Bittensor: Text Clustering uses 'Bittensor Subnet 13 (Gravity data network) and arXiv' data (https://docs.macrocosmos.ai/subnets/subnet-1-apex/subnet-1-current-competitions/text-clustering-competition). Docs still solicit enterprises via email; no paying customer named.

buybacks.evidence: Substack 'On owner alpha, and funding the fire' (2025-06-20) says only 'We have held out on selling any alpha from our subnets for the first four months' and raises capital via OTC with DSV; no buyback. docs.macrocosmos.ai/llms-full.txt has zero hits for buyback/buy-back/buy back (only the Apex emission 'burn' mechanic for unchallenged solutions, which is protocol emissions, not a buyback). subnetradar.com/subnet/1 lists no buyback.

notes: Prior research (Aug 2026) stands: competition platform, miner-paid $20 fees, no customers. Contradiction: docs list 3 active competitions while the apex.macrocosmos.ai dashboard rendered 0 active and 0 paid out on 2026-10-08 (may be a frontend/data issue). Emission share is ~0.004% so the subnet is effectively unfunded by the chain. X account could not be fetched (403). Verifier: Researcher's record holds. name: DSperse

product.quality_rationale: Sertn is live with a public price list (Free / Team $99 per seat per month / Enterprise custom) and an active Rust codebase (release 14.14.3 on 2026-09-08), plus partner-ecosystem listings (Dell, IBM portal, Oracle PN, RTX supplier ecosystem) but no named paying customer, seat count or revenue figure anywhere.

revenue.basis: Sertn has a purchasable $99/seat/month Team tier and custom Enterprise tier, but no seat count, customer count or revenue figure is published anywhere; proof counts are subnet throughput, not billed usage.
revenue.evidence: Verified 2026-10-08: sertn.ai/llms.txt lists 'Free $0/month ... 3 projects, 10K images', 'Team $99/month per seat: Hosted training, ZK proofs, per-prediction attestation, up to 1K proof artifacts/month', 'Enterprise Custom'. inferencelabs.com/media-room: 'Sertn has crossed 3.1B+ proofs' (2026-07-28), '1B+ proofs ... 19.4M proofs/day' (2026-06-01), Sertn launch post 2026-05-04, '$6.3M' raise (2025-07-26). No revenue anywhere. Not in SubConnect tables (TAO Daily 2026-09-16 / 2026-10-02, Crypto Briefing 2026-09-21).

growth.evidence: No revenue figure at any date. Throughput only: 300M proofs (2025-11-13) to 1B+ (2026-06-01) to 3.1B+ (2026-07-28) per the media room; that is mining volume, not revenue.

customers.evidence: 'the DeFi protocol Benqi uses it to verify AI-driven decisions in finance, and TestMachine uses it to audit social media data processing' (https://subnetalpha.ai/subnet/dsperse/, undated, likely 2025). Media room lists partner-ecosystem entries (Dell 2026-07-01, RTX supplier ecosystem 2026-05-09, IBM Vulcan-SOF portal 2026-05-05, Oracle PN 2026-04-09) which are channel listings, not disclosed paying customers.

buybacks.evidence: Media room (entries through 2026-07-28) contains no buyback announcement; subnetradar.com/subnet/2 lists none; subnetalpha.ai/subnet/dsperse/ has no buyback text; TAO Daily DSperse coverage (Oct 2025 to Feb 2026) is technical/partnership only. name: Teutonic

It replaced Templar after Covenant Labs left Bittensor in April 2026. Output is open models, not a service.
product.quality_rationale: Research subnet with heavy dev activity (subnetradar: 611 commits in 30d, 243 miners) and headline training runs announced by Const (80B in May, 110B in Aug 2026), but nothing a customer can buy; teutonic.ai dashboard showed 'NO ACTIVE CHALLENGE' and 'NO REIGNS YET' on 2026-10-08.

revenue.basis: Checked teutonic.ai, github.com/unarbos/teutonic README, subnetradar and tao.media coverage: no pricing, API, checkout or commercial offer exists; the subnet's product is open model weights.
revenue.evidence: 'Teutonic is a king-of-the-hill pretraining system for Bittensor subnet 3' and the only money reference is 'Subnet registration can spend TAO' (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/unarbos/teutonic/main/README.md, read 2026-10-08). tao.media 2026-05-12 article 'contains no information about revenue models, customers, buybacks, or commercial deployment plans'.

growth.evidence: Pre-revenue at both dates; no figures.

customers.evidence: No customers; participants are miners. 'Miners compete to win the sequence of updates which take the loss lower' (tao.media, 2026-05-12).

buybacks.evidence: No revenue to buy back with; no buyback mentioned on teutonic.ai, the repo, subnetradar or tao.media coverage (searched 2026-10-08).

notes: PRIOR RESEARCH IS STALE: it covered Covenant/Templar. Covenant exited Bittensor 2026-04-09 (tao.media, 2026-05-14); SN3 was reclaimed via Conviction and relaunched as Teutonic, with Const announcing an 80B run (2026-05-11) and 'Teutonic-II-110B' (2026-08-24). GitHub owner 'unarbos' (Arbos) is an individual who also runs Distil SN97. Contradiction: press describes a 110B training run, but the live dashboard shows a benchmark leaderboard with a 'Teutonic-I 10B Technical Report' and no active challenge. Emission share 3.28% (#9) despite zero revenue. Basilica (SN39) economics do not belong here.

Two samples: epoch 25,596 $610.32 (researcher, finalized 2026-10-08 19:56 UTC) and epoch 25,597 $671.87 / 20,336 requests / 72 miners (mine, finalized 21:09 UTC); mean $641. Epoch = 361 blocks x 12 s = 72.2 min = 19.94 epochs/day; $641 x 19.94 = $12,780/day x 365 = ~$4.67M; rounded to $4.5M for the $4.4-4.7M sample range. product.quality_rationale: Mechanism is very active (repo commits daily through 2026-10-07; dashboard shows 272 miner submissions and a 5th batch running 2026-10-08) but there is still no customer-facing API, no pricing and no customers: the site offers only 'Join API waitlist'.

revenue.basis: No sellable product: API is waitlist-only, no Harnyx price published (only competitor per-query prices).
revenue.evidence: harnyx.ai (fetched 2026-10-08): 'Join API waitlist', 'Phase 1'; positions '10x lower per query' vs competitors at '$1.54-$3.68 per query' but gives no own price. subnetalpha.ai: 'Public API access is restricted; the site offers a Join API waitlist'. Repo README has no pricing, customers or revenue (https://github.com/harnyx/harnyx).

growth.evidence: No revenue at any date. Prior research (2026-08-12) also found waitlist-only; unchanged on 2026-10-08.

customers.evidence: None named. Site and subnetalpha describe intended users as 'developers building AI agents and enterprise applications' with integrations for 'OpenClaw, LangChain, CrewAI, n8n'.

buybacks.evidence: Checked harnyx.ai, dashboard.harnyx.ai, repo README and commit log (2026-10-08): no buyback, burn or revenue-share mention. subnetalpha.ai: 'Buyback Notes: None mentioned'.

notes: Dashboard (2026-10-08 20:31 UTC) shows the champion miner earning an estimated '$916/day' at '1,476 a/day' - that is emission income to a miner, not revenue. Emission 0.03% (tao.app). Prior research score 58 lowered to 42 because two more months passed with no API launch. X (@harnyx_ai) not fetchable (403). subnetradar's 'Revenue: $1.6M' is unsupported and ignored.

name: NOVA

product.what_it_is: A 24/7 drug-discovery competition run by Metanova Labs: miners propose candidate molecules (small molecules, nanobodies, search algorithms) against protein targets and are scored by validators. The output is candidate compounds for Metanova's own pipeline, not a product a customer buys.
product.quality_rationale: Competitions are live and the repo is maintained (last commit 2026-09-16; 655 commits), and SN68 holds 2.47% of emissions, but there is no pricing, no named pharma customer, no disclosed wet-lab result and no revenue figure anywhere public.

revenue.basis: No product for sale; monetisation (screening-as-a-service, licensing, token-gated libraries) is still roadmap.
revenue.evidence: metanova-labs.ai/nova (published 2026-09-09, fetched 2026-10-08): wet-lab validation 'By CRO + PARTNERS' with no names; no pricing, customers or revenue. subnetalpha.ai/subnet/nova: 'No current revenue reported', monetisation 'through token-gated access... plus services to pharmaceutical companies' is future; 'fiat revenue expected in months' dates from a July 2025 interview and has not materialised publicly. cryptobriefing (2026-05-09) has no revenue, customer or funding data.

growth.evidence: No revenue at any date; prior research (2026-08-12) also confirmed pre-revenue.

customers.evidence: No pharma customer or CRO named on metanova-labs.ai, in the repo, or in press (cryptobriefing 2026-05-09, cryptonews 2026-03-26: 'It is a game of derisking the assets and generating IP').

buybacks.mechanism: A 2025 team statement that future fiat revenue would flow back into the NOVA token; no mechanism, percentage, address or execution.
buybacks.evidence: Ecosystem coverage (cryptonews.net/news/blockchain/32607133, cited via subnetalpha) says the platform 'can be monetized at every stage... with fiat revenue expected in months, flowing back into their native Nova token over time' (July 2025 framing). Nothing on metanova-labs.ai, the repo or 2026 press describes an executed buyback.

notes: X (@metanova_labs) could not be fetched (403 on x.com, syndication and mirrors), so any 2026 announcement made only on X was not seen. Manifold's Consensus Miami notes (2026-05-08) mention an Opentensor session 'on how to turn subnet submissions into real drug candidates' - no commercial detail. Do not confuse with Nova Ltd (NVMI), a semiconductor company that announced a $200M share repurchase on 2026-09-02. subnetradar's 'Revenue: $32.1M' for SN68 is unsupported (likely market cap) and ignored.

name: Herald

product.what_it_is: A marketplace where PR professionals get articles placed in real news outlets and a code-only verifier checks the article is live, editorial and indexed; clients are meant to fund 'briefs' in TAO/alpha and contributors get paid from emissions. Nothing has been paid to anyone yet.
product.quality_rationale: Code ships (release 0.2.2, commits through 2026-09-29) and the subnet is registered, but the team's own transparency note says 'Placements paid to date: 0' and 'Nothing has been paid to any contributor through Herald yet'; taostats shows 1 active miner vs 8 validators and emission is 0%.

revenue.basis: No client brief has transacted; the $32,000 brief on the site is an illustrative pilot.
revenue.evidence: Herald docs transparency note dated 25 September 2026: 'Nothing has been paid to any contributor through Herald yet.' and 'Placements paid to date: 0.' (https://www.heraldmedia.ai/docs). Site: pricing 'USD-priced, funded in alpha or TAO', dashboard 'live network data unavailable', counters at 0 (https://www.heraldmedia.ai, fetched 2026-10-08).

growth.evidence: No revenue at either date (prior research 2026-08-12: pre-revenue; 2026-09-25 transparency note: 0 placements paid).

customers.evidence: No client named. The '$32,000 brief producing four verified placements across Tier 1 outlets including Reuters and The Guardian' on heraldmedia.ai is presented as a pilot example (subnetalpha.ai summary), not a booked customer.

buybacks.evidence: Site, docs and repo (release 0.2.0 PR #15, 2026-09-24) describe only emissions-to-contributors and burning 'the unearned rest' to UID 0 ('HERALD_BURN_UNEARNED'); no revenue-funded alpha purchase anywhere.

notes: Release 0.2.0 (2026-09-24) moved from miner neurons to 'contributor submissions' with 'Weights now go only to UID 0 and the UID of HERALD_INCENTIVE_HOTKEY'. The docs' reference to the 'finney' network means Bittensor mainnet, not a testnet. Emission 0% in batch snapshot; taostats metagraph 2026-10-08: 8 active validators, 1 active miner. tao.app shows 485.81 alpha owner-locked (perpetual) - a conviction lock, not a buyback. subnetradar's 'Revenue: $3.1M' is unsupported and ignored. No X account.

name: Leadpoet

product.what_it_is: A B2B sales-intelligence SaaS: it finds companies showing buying signals, supplies verified contacts and runs email/LinkedIn outreach. Miners on SN71 compete to improve the research agent behind it.
product.quality_rationale: Live, self-serve pricing ($100 and $500/month tiers), named customers and testimonials, Forbes and Yahoo coverage, repo commits on 2026-10-08. Held back because the revenue figure is disputed ($1M run-rate Feb 2026 vs $30K ARR Aug 2026) and SN71 currently has 0% emission with only 2 active miners.

revenue.basis: SubConnect Bittensor Revenue Index Vol I (Aug 2026) p.28, read from the page image: 'ESTIMATED ANNUAL REVENUE $30K', 'REVENUE CONFIDENCE HIGH', with 'an expected annual revenue of $200k end of Q3' from pilots. The Forbes Feb 2026 '$1M annualized run rate' could not be opened (403/CAPTCHA, incl. via archive and jina proxies) and is contradicted by SubConnect's later, team-informed $30K, so $30K is kept.
revenue.evidence: SubConnect p.28: 'The subnet has secured paying enterprise customers, including a publicly traded company generating billions in annual revenue and a leading U.S. investment bank. Additional enterprise pilots, Dropbox is the first one announced, are currently underway, creating an expected annual revenue of $200k end of Q3'. leadpoet.com/pricing (2026-10-08): Launch $100/mo, Accelerate $500/mo, Scale custom. Yahoo Finance 2026-10-06: 'clients including Dropbox', no revenue. subnetalpha: 'early paid enterprise pilot' (May 2026), no figures.

growth.evidence: Two figures conflict and the earlier one is unverifiable: Forbes 2026-02-02 '$1M annualized run rate' (press, team-sourced, blocked on 2026-10-08) vs SubConnect Aug 2026 $30K ARR with HIGH confidence and a $200K end-Q3 target. Q3 has ended with no new figure. Pricing tiers suggest a handful of self-serve customers at $30K ARR; cannot call this growing or declining.

customers.evidence: leadpoet.com (fetched 2026-10-08) shows testimonials from Tyler Carlson (Taureau Group), Timon Agar (Chutes AI), Max Sebti (Score), Massimo Peiret (Margin) and logos incl. Fundable, Dropbox, Mutt Data, deAPI. Yahoo Finance 2026-10-06: Leadpoet 'serves clients including Dropbox'. Prior research cited Forbes: 26 paying B2B customers (Feb 2026), not re-verifiable today.

buybacks.mechanism: Design intent only: fiat-paying customers, with the backend requiring/burning SN71 alpha per fulfilled lead. No address, dashboard, executed buy or burn count published.
buybacks.evidence: SubConnect p.28: 'REVENUE-FUNDED ALPHA BUYS: PLANNED'; 'all platforms that use the subnet will ultimately require Alpha to access subnet-generated intelligence'. subnetalpha: 'Every use of the Leadpoet service requires burning a unit of Leadpoet Alpha' (podcast summary). No buyback/burn text on leadpoet.com, the leadpoet/leadpoet README, or subnet71.com (2026-10-08).

notes: Chain: tao.app 'Emission 0%' and batch snapshot 0.0%; taostats metagraph 2026-10-08: 7 active validators, 2 active miners. subnet71.com round 'Sep 25 - Oct 8' ended with 'No champion was published' (champion score 5.75 vs baseline 1.80). Company clearly active (repo commits 2026-10-08; Yahoo 2026-10-06 profile of founder Gavin Zaentz) despite zero subnet emission. Astrid Intelligence plc RNS 2026-03-20 (~2,366 TAO-equivalent in SN71) gives no revenue data. X post summarising Forbes not openable (403/402). subnetradar's '$6.7M' is unsupported and ignored. Verifier: Contradictions: (1) Forbes $1M (Feb) vs SubConnect $30K (Aug) - 30x apart, newer kept. (2) The researcher's 'testimonials and logos' on leadpoet.com did not render in my fetch (page shows no testimonials or logos), so the named-customer list is only partly corroborated (Dropbox via Yahoo and SubConnect-as-pilot). (3) subnetrada

verified.notes: ARR and buyback status unchanged; SubConnect p.28 was read directly (it was only cited from prior research before) and adds a $200K end-Q3 expectation and names the Dropbox engagement as a pilot, not a closed customer; Forbes remains unverifiable and is kept only as a flagged prior.

name: StreetVision by NATIX

product.what_it_is: NATIX's subnet where miners trained vision models (roadwork detection, street scenes) on NATIX dashcam footage. The subnet has been deliberately switched off since May 2026: all miner emissions are burned until NATIX's new Physical AI roadmap goes live.
product.quality_rationale: No subnet product is usable: validator code burns 100% of weights to UID 0 (commit 'chore: burn rewards' 2026-05-06, no commits since 2026-05-07), NATIX blog 2026-05-07 confirms the burn, emission is 0% and taostats shows 1 active miner vs 9 validators (2026-10-08).

revenue.basis: Subnet is halted and burning emissions; NATIX company revenue (data sales) is not attributable to SN72.
revenue.evidence: NATIX blog listing, post dated 2026-05-07: '100% of miner emissions on the NATIX Subnet (Subnet 72) on Bittensor are being burned until our new Physical AI roadmap goes live in a few months.' (https://www.natix.network/blog). Repo last commit 2026-05-07; 2026-05-06 'chore: burn rewards' (https://github.com/natixnetwork/streetvision-subnet/commits/main). NATIX 2026-10-07 data sale post contains no mention of Bittensor, StreetVision, subnet 72 or alpha.

growth.evidence: No subnet revenue at either date (prior research 2026-08-12 and today). Company-level: NATIX signed a 'six-figure' 3,000-hour data sale on 2026-10-07, but it is $NATIX protocol revenue, not SN72.

customers.evidence: No subnet customer. NATIX the company names Valeo (2026-09-10 blog) and an unnamed 'AI lab developing general world models' (2026-10-07) as data buyers; these buy NATIX data, not subnet output.

buybacks.evidence: NATIX's buyback-and-burn applies to the $NATIX token, not SN72 alpha: 'Customers pay for NATIX data in stable or fiat currencies. That revenue becomes protocol revenue that flows back to the network with our buy-back and burn mechanism'; 224,971,878 $NATIX burned in Q2+Q3 2026 (https://www.natix.network/blog/natix-data-sale-world-model-lab, 2026-10-07). The May 2025 launch post promised subnet-insight revenue 'toward buybacks and burns' but no alpha buy has ever been evidenced.

notes: Prior research (halted, score 18) still holds; now five months into a halt the team said would last 'a few months'. SN72 was explicitly named among the 57 subnets whose emissions Opentensor halted on 2026-06-22 (ourcryptotalk.com), with weekly Monday reviews for reinstatement; no reinstatement found. Owner-locked 304,503 alpha (decaying) is a conviction lock, not a buyback. The May 2026 post and Sept 2026 progress update returned 404 on direct fetch; burn quote is from the blog index excerpt. X not fetchable (403). subnetradar's '$3.1M' is unsupported and ignored.

name: Gittensor

product.what_it_is: Pays open-source developers in subnet alpha for merged pull requests to whitelisted GitHub repos, with validators scoring code quality. Operated by Ventura Labs. There is no product sold to anyone; emissions flow out to contributors.
product.quality_rationale: Mechanism is live and used by miners (751 commits on repo, active issues), but usable only by miners; no customer, no API, no pricing page.

revenue.basis: Architecture has no inbound payment; subnet pays developers, nobody pays the subnet.
revenue.evidence: README: miners 'earn TAO cryptocurrency by submitting merged pull requests to whitelisted open source repositories'; 'No explicit revenue model, pricing structure, or identified customer base' (https://github.com/entrius/gittensor, 2026-10-08). Ventura Labs site discloses a fee model only for its other subnet Allways (SN7: 'Every transaction pays a flat 1% fee'), none for Gittensor (https://venturalabs.ai/, 2026-10-08). Not named in the Sept-2026 revenue-era coverage (https://cryptobriefing.com/bittensor-subnets-annualized-revenue/).

growth.evidence: Pre-revenue at both dates.

customers.evidence: Only participants are miner-developers earning emissions; no paying customers. subnetalpha: 'Current: Pilot phase with select repositories' (https://subnetalpha.ai/subnet/gittensor/).

buybacks.evidence: No buyback mentioned on gittensor.io, the repo README, subnetalpha, or venturalabs.ai (all checked 2026-10-08). No revenue exists to fund one.

notes: Prior research stands. Ventura Labs now also pitches a 'SparkInfer' inference benchmark ('SparkInfer v0.5.4 beat SGLang on all five matched workloads') and GitHub issue #1794 shows SparkInfer workloads being qualified on SN74, so the subnet may be drifting toward inference-performance competitions; still no paying buyer. gittensor.io is a JS app that returned only a title to the fetcher. A TaoOutsider X thread asks when 'agents' will generate revenue for SN74, implying none yet. Search budget ran out before a direct X check of @gittensor_io.

name: Hippius

product.what_it_is: Decentralised cloud storage (S3-compatible object storage, encrypted Drive, a Hugging Face-style model hub, VMs) run by The Nerve Lab on its own chain bridged to Bittensor. Customers pay in credits (1 credit = $1) by Stripe card or TAO.
product.quality_rationale: Live product with published pricing, Stripe checkout, and four named-customer case studies published Aug-Sep 2026; no disclosed revenue figure.

revenue.basis: SubConnect Bittensor Revenue Index Vol I (Aug 2026) p.19, read from the page image: 'ESTIMATED ANNUAL REVENUE $200K', 'REVENUE CONFIDENCE MEDIUM', 'currently generating an estimated $200,000 in annualized revenue'. No first-party revenue dashboard; hipstats.com renders 0 blocks / 0 nodes and no figures.
revenue.evidence: hippius.com/pricing (2026-10-08): 'Pay-as-you-go $6.00/TB billed hourly', S3 Pro $5.30/TB ($53/mo, 10 TB), S3 Business $4.90/TB ($245/mo, 50 TB), S3 Enterprise $4.65/TB ($465/mo, 100 TB), '>100 TB from $4.00 per TB', '1 credit = $1'. Alphanomics: 'Fiat via Stripe, crypto direct with $TAO'. Blog case studies dated 2026-08-18 (Minos), 08-25 (Vidaio), 09-14 (Ditto), 09-24 (Zapme Social). hippius-desktop PR #426 'subscription plans' merged 2026-09-04. SubConnect p.19: 'REVENUE-FUNDED ALPHA BUYS: REVENUE-SHARE MODEL ANNOUNCED'.

growth.evidence: One dated revenue figure ($200K, SubConnect Aug 2026). Qualitative positives since: four named case studies (Aug 18 - Sep 24, 2026), referral program (2026-08-24), Drive subscription plans (PR #426, 2026-09-04), Shared Drives (2026-09-30), 334 commits/30d (subnetradar). None of these carry a revenue number.

customers.evidence: Blog case studies: 'Zapme Social Runs on Hippius Distributed Cloud Storage' (2026-09-24), 'How Ditto Runs Its AI Memory Storage on Hippius' (2026-09-14), 'How Vidaio Cut S3 Storage Costs by 50% With Hippius' (2026-08-25), 'Minos Case Study: S3-Compatible Storage for AI Genomics' (2026-08-18) (https://hippius.com/blog). Developer/SMB buyers; no customer count disclosed.

buybacks.mechanism: Revenue-share, not buyback: storage revenue is split 60% miners / 30% validators+nominators / 10% treasury (subnetalpha), with dividends to locked-hAlpha stakers; Alphanomics explicitly avoids burns and recycles revenue into growth.
buybacks.evidence: hippius.com/alphanomics (2026-10-08): revenue is recycled rather than burned; 'Locked hAlpha dividends flow into staker shared pool'; no buyback statement. subnetalpha.ai/subnet/hippius: '60% of revenue to the storage miners..., 30% to validators and nominators..., and 10% to a treasury'. SubConnect p.19: 'Earlier economic updates also introduced revenue-sharing mechanisms linked to Alpha' and lists alpha buys as 'REVENUE-SHARE MODEL ANNOUNCED', not YES.

notes: The $200K ARR is a SubConnect estimate I could not corroborate first-party (hipstats loads empty via fetcher; no revenue dashboard). Treat as stale as of Aug 2026; customer wins since suggest it is not shrinking. Owner-locked 100,000 alpha is a lock, not a buyback. Revenue dividends to hAlpha stakers is value accrual but not a buyback under this rubric. Prior research recorded $0.003/GB/mo (= $3/TB); the pricing page now shows $6/TB PAYG, so list price appears to have doubled since August. Verifier: $200K is an index estimate >60 days old with no first-party corroboration. Owner-locked 100,000 alpha and staker dividends are not buybacks. The researcher's note that PAYG doubled from $3/TB to $6/TB could not be re-checked (no archived pricing page available to this tool). Sanity check: $200K ARR at $4-6/TB implies only ~3-4 PB billed; plausible for a small storage business.

verified.notes: Nothing material; read SubConnect p.19 directly (confirms $200K MEDIUM and 'revenue-share model announced' rather than buybacks) and replaced the empty hipstats.com source with the subnetalpha revenue-split source.

name: Ormas

product.what_it_is: An 'Outcomes API' for coding work: a client posts a code change plus the test that proves it, miners quote a firm price and deliver a branch, and the miner is paid only if the test passes. Run by Heron Cove LLC. Replaced the previous occupant of SN76 (Phylax, which prior research covered).
product.quality_rationale: Self-described 'in development'; validator acceptance not live; only the operator's own miner/validator/gateway run; a six-ticket 'production case study' is referenced but not reachable.

revenue.basis: A per-task 'settled USD' ledger exists internally (used to compute miner compensation) but no figure is published; cannot tell whether any external client has paid.
revenue.evidence: Site: 'Independent validator acceptance is not yet live.' (https://ormas.ai, 2026-10-08). README: 'Development candidate as of September 23... Independent validator admission and the combined validator service remain release work.' (https://github.com/heroncovelabs/ormas-subnet). PR #22: compensation based on 'settled USD x the published rate version (2x since 2026-10-05T15:00Z, earned-bid-2x-v1)' (merged 2026-10-05). Docs mention 'Production case study: six tickets, October 2026' (https://ormas.ai/docs) but the case-study and outcomes-api sub-pages returned 404.

growth.evidence: No revenue figure at any date. Prior research (Aug 2026) covered a different project (Phylax) on this netuid, so there is no comparable prior figure.

customers.evidence: No customers named. Search summary: 'Heron Cove LLC running both a miner and a validator on SN76 and operating the gateway that settles work', i.e. the operator is currently its own counterparty. 'Production case study: six tickets, October 2026' hints at at least one client job but is unverifiable (page 404).

buybacks.evidence: No buyback mentioned on ormas.ai, docs, or the repo README/PRs (checked 2026-10-08); PR #22 notes only 'treasury top-ups still planned'.

notes: Netuid 76 changed hands: prior research described Phylax (phyi.dev security scanning); the chain identity, website and repo now all say Ormas / Heron Cove LLC. Treat prior research as obsolete. Emission is 0% and market cap $261K, so the subnet is barely alive on-chain despite active commits (PRs #22-#24 in Oct 2026). api.ormas.ai resolves (returns 404 at root), consistent with an operator-run gateway.

name: Liquidity

product.what_it_is: A vote-directed liquidity-mining program: alpha holders vote on which Uniswap V3 pools (mainly wTAO pairs) get incentives, and miners who supply liquidity there earn subnet emissions. No fees are charged to anyone.
product.quality_rationale: Live API and ~$509K of incentivised LP positions, but the only users are miners/voters; nothing is sold and there is no buyer.

revenue.basis: No fee capture anywhere; subnet pays emissions out to LPs.
revenue.evidence: README 'contains no information about fees, revenue mechanisms, or buyback programs' (https://github.com/creativebuilds/sn77, 2026-10-08). Live API: 6 pools, wTAO/WETH totalWeight 7986.2 and wTAO/USDC 2013.7, other 4 pools near-zero weight (https://77.creativebuilds.io/pools, 2026-10-08); 17 positions totalling about $509,044 USD of liquidity (https://77.creativebuilds.io/positions, 2026-10-08). That is other people's capital, not revenue.

growth.evidence: Pre-revenue at both dates. Incentivised liquidity (not revenue) moved from $559,665 (sn77.xyz metadata, Aug 2026) to ~$509K across 17 positions (positions API, 2026-10-08), roughly flat.

customers.evidence: Participants are LP miners (17 positions) and a handful of voters (4 and 3 voters on the two active pools per /pools API); no paying customers.

buybacks.evidence: Nothing on sn77.xyz, the repo, or the API about buybacks (2026-10-08). tokenomist.ai labels the token's buyback 'Dynamic' but that is a generic field with no mechanism or evidence (https://tokenomist.ai/liquidity/unlock-events). No revenue exists to fund one.

notes: Prior research confirmed. sn77.xyz is a JS page that returns only a title to the fetcher. Owner-locked 200,000 alpha is a lock, not a buyback. Pools are 6 now vs 5 in August, positions 17 vs 18. Emission 0.134% is very low for a $7.6M market cap.

name: Umi

product.what_it_is: UMI (Universal Motion Intelligence) is the pivot of Vocence (voice AI) into motion understanding; first product '/sign' translates sign language to speech and back using a phone camera, with models developed by open competition on SN78. The app is announced but not yet released.
product.quality_rationale: Press-released 2 Oct 2026 with a TestFlight beta promised for 15 Oct and App Store 15 Nov; early-access and pilot inquiries only; former Vocence storefront (vocence.ai) now 404.

revenue.basis: No product shipped yet; previous paid product (Vocence TTS credits) is offline.
revenue.evidence: Press release 2026-10-02: early access and pilots 'open now'; web app 'coming week', 'TestFlight beta: October 15', 'App Store launch: November 15'; no pricing, customers or revenue (https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/02/tmt-newswire/globenewswire/umi-launches-bittensor-ai-network-for-motion-to-meaning-intelligence-starting-with-sign-language/2437997). umi.vision lists no pricing or customers (https://www.umi.vision, 2026-10-08). https://www.vocence.ai returned HTTP 404 (2026-10-08). Repo: 'No pricing or buyback mechanisms mentioned' (https://github.com/Umi-BitSign/umi).

growth.evidence: Prior research (Aug 2026) found a live Vocence checkout ($12/4000 credits) but no volume; that storefront is now 404 and the new product has not launched. No revenue figure at either date.

customers.evidence: Press release: 'clinical pilot inquiries and launch partnerships are open now'; no pilots or customers named (2026-10-02).

buybacks.evidence: No buyback mentioned in the press release, umi.vision, or the repo (checked 2026-10-08).

notes: What changed since August: Vocence pivoted to UMI; abittensorjourney (2026-09-12) rates the pivot 3/6 and calls real-time multi-subnet orchestration 'the hardest engineering challenge'. A search summary claimed Vocence was 'deregistered but is now back on the network'; I could not open a primary source for that and the batch file shows SN78 live with 0.012% emission. Co-founder/Head of AI is Koyuki Nakamori (ex-OpenTensor Foundation). Repo describes a 'temporary registration bridge' for miners.
